description: This file defines the ChiSquared class which provides methods to perform statistical calculations related to the chi-squared distribution, including p-values, inverse distributions, and chi-squared tests.

classes.name: ChiSquared
classes.description: A class providing statistical methods related to the chi-squared distribution, including p-value calculations and goodness-of-fit tests.

methods.name: distributionRightTail
methods.description: Calculates the right-tailed probability (p-value) of the chi-squared distribution for a given value and degrees of freedom.

methods.name: distributionLeftTail
methods.description: Calculates the left-tailed probability (CDF or PDF) of the chi-squared distribution based on input value, degrees of freedom, and tail type.

methods.name: inverseRightTail
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the right-tailed probability (quantile function) for the chi-squared distribution.

methods.name: inverseLeftTail
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the left-tailed probability (quantile function) for the chi-squared distribution.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs a chi-square test to evaluate the goodness-of-fit between observed and expected frequencies.
